messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we're rolling out a small update to review form flows to handle LOA, mid-cycle hires, and contractor conversions. Wanted to capture manager Qs here so we can finalize copy.
Liam (Manager - Backend): Appreciate it. Two asks: make the category a dropdown and let me attach PRs easily (copy/paste links).
Sofia (Manager - Growth): Also need clarity on whether new hires get base-level ratings or are always marked as "insufficient data" until 90 days.
Maya (People Ops): Proposal: dropdown categories: Full cycle / Partial (LOA) / New hire <90d / Contractor->FTE / Insufficient data. Each requires a 1-line rationale. New hires default to "New hire <90d"; managers can still provide an observational comment but those entries will be treated as non-final until calibration.
Raj (HRBP): Operational note: provisional ratings are allowed but must be flagged using the new "Flag for calibration" checkbox. Flagged items are pulled into the calibration packet with an auto-generated note showing LOA/convert dates.
Liam (Manager - Backend): Good. For LOA threshold, what's the cutoff?
Maya (People Ops): Use a pragmatic cutoff: >30% of review period qualifies as Partial (LOA). We'll pre-fill LOA and conversion dates from HRIS when available; otherwise manager inputs the dates.
Sofia (Manager - Growth): Can managers attach evidence in-line? E.g., link to campaigns, Notion docs, PRs? Saves time during calibration.
Maya (People Ops): Yes — forms will allow multiple evidence links (paste or upload). We'll add a short guidance: "Attach 1-3 key artifacts that show impact during the period you are rating."
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: forms due EOD Fri. Calibration slots booked next week; request expanded slot if you have >4 flagged items: https://calendly.internal/redwood/calibration-requests :bell: 
Liam (Manager - Backend): Edge case: contractor that was on project-only evaluation earlier in cycle and then converted. Should we rate them as contractor + conversion note, or as FTE for the whole cycle?
Raj (HRBP): Treat as Contractor->FTE with conversion date noted. Calibration will view pre-conversion work as contractor-period contribution; managers should give context in the 1-line rationale.
Sofia (Manager - Growth): Will exceptions be allowed for missed deadlines (e.g., manager on emergency LOA)?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — managers can request a one-week exception via the Helpdesk link on the forms page. For longer exceptions, escalate to your HRBP. We'll include the link in the updated email.
Maya (People Ops): I'll push the form update (dropdown + flags + evidence field + HRIS prefill) in ~15 minutes and send a note with screenshots. If any manager wants a 10-min walkthrough before publish, DM me and I'll hop on. :thumbsup:
